meta.title: Where Is Pat?
meta.textType: story: finding a person from a description

paragraphs: On Saturday, the school fair opened at nine o'clock. May was eleven, and she looked after her brother Pat. Pat was eight. May was looking at a necklace and a ring at a stall. Then she turned round. Pat was not there. "Pat is missing!" she said. May was worried, so she ran to the information desk.

A friendly police officer was at the desk, and Teacher Kim was there, too. "Please help me," said May. "I don't want to lose my brother." "Where did you see him last?" asked Teacher Kim. "He was at the stall with me," said May. "What does he look like?" asked the police officer. "Pat is small, and he has short black hair," said May. "He is wearing a red cap and blue shorts. His T-shirt is green with a white stripe." "We will find out where he is," said the police officer.

Lily and Mia came to the desk, and Teacher Kim asked them to help. "Look for a boy with a red cap," she said. The girls looked everywhere. They looked at the book stall and the food stalls. Then Mia saw a green T-shirt with a white stripe. "There he is!" she said. Pat was at the stage. He was watching a drum show when the girls found him. He entered the crowd near the stage because he liked the drums.

Lily ran to tell May. May ran to the stage and hugged Pat. "I did not hear you, May," said Pat. "Sorry, May," he said. "Stay with me, Pat," said May. The police officer came to the stage and smiled. Pat held May's hand, and they watched the drums together.
text.summary: May looks after her brother Pat at the school fair. Pat is missing, so May describes him to a police officer, and Lily and Mia find him.
